meta.move: Long messages with curly quotes and a concession
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Start with Owen's zero.

I want to be fair to Owen. I compared the essay with his in-class writing from September 24: 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices throughout, no quotations. This essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and none of those errors.
Forty minutes in a classroom against a whole weekend with the play open. Of course it's cleaner. Show me both pieces, and tell me who decided on the zero before anyone called me.
You’re right that the checker alone proves nothing. I’m taking it off the table. I’m relying on the writing and the version history.
Okay. The version history: what does it show, and when? Put it in front of me.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn and an answer on who decided to enter it before anyone called me, and I still want the version history in front of me with its dates and times. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: Still at her opening position, with nothing agreed, so she wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record. The fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got near it.
What moved her: Nothing moved her position yet, but your comparison with his September 24 in-class writing came closest, because it was specific, dated and tied to his own work. She answered it with the weekend-at-home defence, and you never replied to that.
What cost ground: You never owned entering the zero before calling her, and she asked about it twice. You also named the version history without giving a single date or time, so she had nothing to check.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your evidence did not get near that night, since no times came out, and it proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When you bring up the version history, give the dates and times in the same breath, and own the zero before the call in one sentence first.
